Control mode injects outcomes; selection mode directly probes selector with injected failures.
Combat mode executes actual Update and privileged rule-agent inputs; not human adaptation evidence.
Improving/declining switch agent profiles across round thirds. Combat repeated_failures uses novice input, not forced death.
Selection rows cover candidates/repetition exclusions; starts also records forced Step/Rage starts sampled after each Update. Missing authored gates are not individually explained.
